description: This file implements a WebSocket-based Speech-to-Text (STT) service that interfaces with the Cartesia Live transcription API. It includes classes for configuring options, managing connections, processing WebSocket messages, and handling transcription frames, with focus on real-time speech recognition and integration with an external API.

classes.name: CartesiaLiveOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Cartesia Live STT service, managing transcription parameters such as model, language, encoding, and sample rate.

classes.name: CartesiaSTTService
classes.description: A WebSocket-based Speech-to-Text service class that connects to Cartesia's API for real-time transcription, handling connection management, message processing, and transcription frame output.

methods.name: CartesiaLiveOptions.to_dict
methods.description: Converts configuration options into a dictionary of key-value pairs for use in WebSocket URL parameters or other settings.

methods.name: CartesiaLiveOptions.items
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the configuration options as (key, value) pairs.

methods.name: CartesiaLiveOptions.get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific configuration value by key, with optional default.

methods.name: CartesiaLiveOptions.from_json
methods.description: Creates an instance of CartesiaLiveOptions from a JSON string.

methods.name: CartesiaSTTService.can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: CartesiaSTTService.start
methods.description: Initiates the connection to the WebSocket and starts the STT process.

methods.name: CartesiaSTTService.stop
methods.description: Stops the service and disconnects from the WebSocket.

methods.name: CartesiaSTTService.cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing transcription and disconnects.

methods.name: CartesiaSTTService.start_metrics
methods.description: Starts collection of processing and time-to-first-byte metrics.

methods.name: CartesiaSTTService.process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling speaking events and controlling WebSocket communication.

methods.name: CartesiaSTTService.run_stt
methods.description: Handles audio data for transcription, sends it over WebSocket, and yields transcription frames.

methods.description: Continuously receives messages from WebSocket, reconnecting if needed.

methods.name: _process_response(self, data)
methods.description: Handles JSON-decoded WebSocket message data, routing transcripts and errors.

methods.name: _handle_transcription( self, transcript: str, is_final: bool, language: Optional[Language] = None )
methods.description: Processes finalized transcriptions with tracing (actual implementation to be provided).

methods.name: _on_transcript(self, data)
methods.description: Handles raw transcript data received from WebSocket messages, converting to frames and managing finalization.
